task.title: Tooltip is partially visible and disappears while scrolling after navigating to the "Unknown" button: A11y_Azure Databases extension for VS Code - Data Modeler and Account Dashboard_Account Overview_Functional
task.body:
[A11y Agency plugin ](https://vigilant-adventure-v9qpqwn.pages.github.io/all/#plugins/a11y?q=a11y)is available to help with accessibility bug remediation.
The required tag has already been added: agency:agent=a11y:a11y-agent@company. Assign the bug to Agency to use it. Please try it and share feedback on whether the remediation guidance was useful at [CAIA11yAgency@microsoft.com](mailto:CAIA11yAgency@microsoft.com).

**Tags:** #A11yFunctional; #A11yTCS; #agency:agent=a11y:a11y-agent@company; #Benchmark; #Win32; #DesktopApp; #SH_AzureDatabasesextensionforVSCode-DataModelerandAccountDashboard_Win32_Nov26; #Azure Cosmos DB extension for VS Code; #Win11; #ES Chat; #FTP;

### User Experience:
Keyboard and low-vision users may be unable to read the complete tooltip information associated with the "Unknown" button, making it difficult to understand the purpose or additional information provided for the control.

### Repro Steps:
Open VS code -> Open Azure Resources -> Select subscription -> Expand Azure Cosmos DB -> Select test account -> Open Account Overview 

### Actual Result:

- The tooltip content is partially clipped/not completely visible.
- When the page is scrolled, the tooltip disappears, preventing users from accessing the complete information.

### Expected Result:
The tooltip should be fully visible and readable when displayed. Users should be able to access the complete tooltip information without it being clipped or unexpectedly disappearing during interaction

### How to Fix

Ensure that the tooltip:
- Is positioned within the visible viewport without clipping.
- Displays its complete content.
- Remains available while the triggering control has focus or while the user interacts with the tooltip content, as applicable.

Environment details:
Application Name: Azure Databases extension for VS Code - Data Modeler and Account Dashboard
App: vscode 1.145.1 (User Setup)
OS Version: Windows 11 enterprise 26H2. (OS build 26300.9711)
